raw_text: Cache synchronous, expensive `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, and `document.cookie` reads in memory. Use a `Map` (not a hook) across utilities and event handlers; sync cache on writes. Invalidate for external changes: `window.addEventListener('storage', (e) => { if (e.key) storageCache.delete(e.key) })`; on `visibilitychange`, when visible, invalidate cookie cache.
